historical_sync.rule: Only assertions on the CURRENT pr-review-judge frontmatter / current hash were changed (released state; key must stay absent; re-adding it is a negative control). impl-review-loop and open-pr keep their disable assertions. source_blob_sha1 / source_sha256, the D5-time to D14-time records (historical_pre_d8 / d13 / d14) and every test count are kept; the pre-D15 current values are recorded as historical_pre_d15. D6 / D7 / D11 manifests are unchanged and keep their historical evidence boundaries.

runtime_acceptance.rule: AC4 is accepted only by the main Claude Code session explicitly dispatching pr-reviewer for the D15 Draft PR (number and HEAD given) and independently checking SubAgent start / terminal payload, the four fields, per-step evidence, effective permission mode, HEAD equality and Reviewer GitHub write 0. A general code-review SubAgent PASS, a fixture result or the Reviewer's own output is never this acceptance.

count_evidence: Measured with pytest --co and a real run; the runner independently verifies per-file counts and JUnit outcome. Static text / manifest checks only: no GitHub call, no model call and no SubAgent dispatch.
rollback: Revert the single D15 PR: it restores the pr-review-judge frontmatter disable, the D13 sentence and the pr-reviewer note, removes this manifest, the D15 test and CI lane, and restores the D4 / D5 / D8 current hashes and the D6 / D7 / D11 / D13 / D14 assertions.
ci_binding: The i4-4d15 job runs this manifest through scripts/ci/run_stage1b1_tests.py and the full tests/stage_i4 directory; no new permissions, runner or secrets.
